mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, date, qty, wait_qty, inventory_age_days
mapper.select: WITH virtualTransFlowDetail AS ( SELECT virtual_inventory_detail_id, sum(qty) as qty FROM virtual_trans_flow_detail WHERE is_deleted = false and #{date} > trade_time group by virtual_inventory_detail_id ) select vid.id as virtual_inventory_detail_id, vid.sku_id, vid.warehouse_id, vid.virtual_warehouse_id, vid.bill_date as billDate, vtfd.qty from virtual_inventory_detail vid left join virtualTransFlowDetail vtfd on vid.id = vtfd.virtual_inventory_detail_id where vid.is_deleted = false order by vid.id asc

WITH virtualInventoryDetailHis AS ( select vid.sku_id, vid.warehouse_id, vid.virtual_warehouse_id, sum(vidh.wait_qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as inventoryAgeQty from virtual_inventory_detail_his vidh left join virtual_inventory_detail vid on vidh.virtual_inventory_detail_id = vid.id and vid.is_deleted = false where vidh.is_deleted = false and vid.sku_id = #{params.skuId} and vid.warehouse_id = #{params.warehouseId} and vid.virtual_warehouse_id = #{params.virtualWarehouseId} and vidh.date = #{dto.date} group by vid.sku_id,vid.warehouse_id,vid.virtual_warehouse_id ),VirtualInventoryHis AS ( SELECT vi.sku_id, vi.warehouse_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(vih.qty) AS virtualQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualUsableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualFrozenQty FROM virtual_inventory_his vih left join virtual_inventory vi on vih.virtual_inventory_id = vi.id and vi.is_deleted = false WHERE vih.is_deleted = false and vid.sku_id = #{params.skuId} and vid.warehouse_id = #{params.warehouseId} and vid.virtual_warehouse_id = #{params.virtualWarehouseId} and vidh.date = #{dto.date} GROUP BY vi.sku_id, vi.warehouse_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id ) select vidh.sku_id, vidh.warehouse_id, vidh.virtual_warehouse_id, case when vih.virtualQty = 0 then 0 else vidh.inventoryAgeQty / virtualQty end as avgInventoryAgeDays, vih.virtualQty, vih.virtualUsableQty , vih.virtualFrozenQty from virtualInventoryDetailHis vidh left join VirtualInventoryHis vih on vidh.sku_id = vih.sku_id and vidh.warehouse_id = vih.warehouse_id and vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vih.virtual_warehouse_id
